dashboard.subtitle: Office overview: deadlines, exceptions and workload at a glance.

exceptions.title: Exceptions
exceptions.none: No exceptions — all dossiers within expectations.

dashboard.aiUsage: AI usage (demo cap): {used} / {cap} tokens. All AI output is a proposal until a human approves it.

myDay.title: My day
myDay.subtitle: Every open task across your dossiers, most urgent first.

tasks.plan_van_aanpak: Draft plan of approach (plan van aanpak)
tasks.rekening_verantwoording: Annual account to the court (rekening & verantwoording)
tasks.maandoverzicht_client: Send monthly account overview to client

tasksUi.evidenceHint: Record how this step was performed and the evidence for it. This feeds the dossier's audit trail.
tasksUi.evidencePlaceholder: e.g. Mijn CBM reference, confirmation number…

dossiers.title: Dossiers
dossiers.empty: No dossiers yet. Create the first one.

newDossier.title: New dossier
newDossier.subtitle: Register a client. The statutory task schedule is generated at activation.
newDossier.syntheticNote: Demo environment: enter synthetic data only — never real personal data.

overview.needStartDate: A start date is required before activation.
overview.activated: Dossier activated — statutory tasks and start playbook generated.
overview.rvConfirmed: Annual account due in month {month}, as instructed by the court.
overview.rvMissing: The court's R&V schedule has not been recorded. No R&V deadline is tracked until you set it — this is an explicit dossier fact, never inferred.
overview.rvSaved: R&V schedule recorded; annual account task generated.

transactions.importHint: One documented CAMT.053 profile. Re-importing the same file never creates duplicates; the raw file is stored immutably.
transactions.empty: Import a CAMT.053 file or add one manually.
transactions.aiDone: AI categorized {count} transactions (marked ✦, review as needed).
transactions.aiUnavailable: AI unavailable — categorize manually or try again later.

letters.packHint: {count} agencies not yet notified. Generates one Dutch letter per agency from the dossier data.
letters.packDone: {count} letters drafted — review and approve below.
letters.contextPlaceholder: Optional context for AI tailoring (e.g. 'client had an income gap in July; propose starting in October')
letters.aiNote: With context, AI tailors the draft. Official letters are always in Dutch; you approve before anything counts as sent.
letters.emptySentence: Generated letters appear here for review and approval.
letters.dutchNote: Official correspondence is always in Dutch, regardless of your UI language.
letters.officialOutput: Official output: Nederlands — all letters are generated in Dutch regardless of UI language.

filings.rvExplainer: The review pack computes every figure from the ledger and checks completeness. It is a working document: the actual filing happens in Mijn CBM, and you remain responsible for its content.

validation.rvScheduleMissing: Court R&V schedule not recorded (Overview tab).
validation.largeExpenses: {detail} expense(s) ≥ €2,000 — consent or court authorization evidence required (LOVT B.D3).
validation.reconciliation: Figures do not reconcile: € {detail} unexplained difference between balance movement and category totals.

filings.notForSubmission: Working document — not for court submission. File via Mijn CBM.
filings.boedelExplainer: Worksheet from the current dossier facts: accounts, debts and income. Due within 4 months of the start of the measure (art. 1:436 BW).
filings.boedelHint: Complete the inventory in Mijn CBM; keep the evidence in the Documents tab.
filings.officialOutput: Official output: Nederlands — court filings are prepared in Dutch regardless of UI language.

rvPack.watermark: WERKDOCUMENT — NOT FOR SUBMISSION. File the R&V via Mijn CBM.
rvPack.title: Annual account {year} — review pack
rvPack.leefgeldNote: Leefgeld account: only opening/closing balance required (LOVT B.B11).
rvPack.largeExpensesHint: Attach consent of the client or the court authorization for each (LOVT B.D3).

validation.reconciliation: Balance movement and category totals differ by € {detail} — investigate categorization/imports before filing.

attachment.bankStatements: Bank statements per account (bank export with logo — app screenshots are not accepted)

rvPack.mijnCbmNote: Filing happens in Mijn CBM (Rechtspraak). Mark the R&V task as submitted with the Mijn CBM reference as evidence.

copilot.intro: Ask anything about this dossier. Answers are grounded in the dossier's own data; the copilot is read-only and cannot change anything.
copilot.suggestion3: Does a €2,300 washing machine need court authorization?
copilot.unavailable: AI is unavailable right now (demo cap or no model access). The rest of Frank OS keeps working.
copilot.readOnlyNote: Read-only copilot: it can look things up and draft, but every action stays with you. BSN and account numbers are redacted before anything reaches the model.

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.subtitle: Incoming post: upload or paste, AI proposes classification and next action, you decide.
inbox.pastePlaceholder: Paste the text of an incoming letter here (demo: text is what the AI triages)…
inbox.aiTriageNote: AI triage proposes; nothing happens without your approval.
inbox.emptySentence: Uploaded documents appear here for AI triage and dossier linking.

payments.title: Payments
payments.subtitle: Proposals from budget plans and leefgeld schedules. Approve, then export as pain.001 — the OS never moves money itself.
payments.empty: No batches yet. Generate proposals from the budget plans.
payments.approveBlocked: Blocked: resolve validation errors and machtiging reviews first.
payments.blockedBanner: {count} item(s) blocked: validation errors or unresolved machtiging review. Approval is disabled until resolved.
payments.demoExportNote: Exported as {filename} — DEMO file, do not deliver to a bank. Real-bank export is disabled outside a configured production environment.
payments.machtigingDisclaimer: This flag signals that consent of the client or authorization of the kantonrechter may be required (LOVT April 2025). It is a review flag, not a legal conclusion — you decide and record the basis.
payments.openBatchExists: An open payment batch already exists — finish or cancel it first.

approveSummary.demoWarning: DEMO batch: the export is labeled 'not for bank submission' and no money ever moves from this system.
approveSummary.ack: I have reviewed every payment in this batch and confirm the approval.
approveSummary.lockWarning: Approval locks the batch and is recorded in the audit log under your name. A locked batch can only be revoked, not edited.

payments.excludeLocked: Batch is locked — exclusions can no longer change.
payments.auditMicrocopy: Approval is recorded in the audit log under your name.
payments.approvedBanner: Batch approved by {name} — locked and recorded in the audit log. The OS never moves money itself.

reason.aggregation: Same-purpose spending this year reaches €2,000 (LOVT B.D3)

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Append-only record of every change: who (human or AI agent), what, and on whose approval.
audit.appendOnlyNote: Audit rows are never updated or deleted by the application. Actor is 'demo-user' until authentication is added.
